validation.command: git diff --check and bounded path review
validation.evidence: No whitespace errors were reported; the approved framework boundary excludes Demo/Project-Orchestrator-Demo.pptx, artifacts/, and the ignored local profile.
The managed workstation has no standalone npm executable, so package creation, package-install testing, and fresh release-candidate verification could not run.

Unrelated Agent Builder and project-status fixtures recursively invoke process.execPath as Code.exe, while the source workstation's intentionally excluded demo PowerPoint differs from the staged copy. These results are environment or exclusion effects, not commit-scoped failures.

residualRisks: The branch is suitable only for transfer to a machine with supported Node.js and npm; it is not merge-ready until npm run check and hosted checks pass.
LinkedIn topic, voice, and public-context quality remain semantic review duties even though measurable contract requirements are regression-tested.
The existing release candidate predates these source changes and must not be treated as current.
P4 trusted-signing, independent-review, operational artifact, revocation, and production-verification blockers remain unchanged.
recommendation: Commit and push the bounded framework-only change set to origin/feat/agent-builder-latest for laptop continuation. Do not merge until npm run check rebuilds and verifies the package, hosted checks pass, and the final branch diff is reviewed.
